name: Game of Thrones Quotes
description: A Game of Thrones quote on every refresh, word-wrapped and centered with the character who said it underneath — only quotes that fit the board, so a Note gets the short ones and a Flagship the long ones too. Optionally only from the characters or houses you choose. 196 quotes from 48 characters, shipped with the plugin — nothing to download, no API key.
author: Oliver Rummeyer

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Optional. Only quotes by these characters. Leave empty for any quote.

houses.title: Houses
houses.description: Optional. Only quotes by members of these houses. Combined with characters, each quote is by one of the chosen characters or from one of the chosen houses.

show_character.title: Show character
show_character.description: Sign the quote with the character's name, shortened to the first name when the full name does not fit. Left off when there is no row for it.

signed_only.title: Only quotes with room for the name
signed_only.description: Skip quotes that leave no row for the character's name. Mostly for a Note, where most quotes take all three rows: it then picks from 21 quotes instead of 54. Has no effect while Show character is off.

skip_crude.title: Skip crude language
skip_crude.description: Leave out the handful of quotes with swearing in them, most of them the Hound's.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.description: Centered puts the name centered underneath; left-aligned puts it flush right.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval
refresh_seconds.description: How long a quote stays on the board before the next one.

quote.description: The quote as board text, unwrapped

character.description: The full name of the character who said it

house.description: The character's house, empty for those without one

block.description: The whole laid-out board as one value, rows separated by newlines. Put this on the first template line to fill the board.

line4.description: Board row 4 of the layout, empty on a Note

line5.description: Board row 5 of the layout, empty on a Note

line6.description: Board row 6 of the layout, empty on a Note
